Here is a wide-field image of the region of the galaxies Messier 81 (right) and Messier 82 (left) as well as NGC 3077 (bottom) and NGC2976 (upper right corner) .



The technical details

Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 II @ F4.5 - IDAS-LPS filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the TheSky6 software
Site: At home
85 exposures of 10 min for 850 minutes
Flat and bias applied
